notes: Ranges the probe found occupied by its own process image are NOT recorded as host limitations; see probe_run.warnings.
MAP_FIXED is never used by this probe. Exact placement is probed through mach_vm_allocate(VM_FLAGS_FIXED), which refuses a collision instead of evicting the existing mapping.

warnings: the lowest placeable page in this process is 0x300000000, which is where its own __PAGEZERO and image end. macOS has no equivalent of vm.mmap_min_addr to read, so min_map_address is left UNKNOWN rather than filled in with a property of the probe binary; under Rosetta this value moves between runs of the same job because the translated image is slid by ASLR

allocation arena [0x100000000, 0x1000000000) walked in contiguous windows of 0x400000 bytes: 7383 placed, 111 already held by the probe process, 35 structurally refused, and 7831 not probed because they lie inside an entry the platform had already described as granting no access. The first two are treated identically on purpose; only the third and fourth are host limitations
